source.author: Kaws
source.title: 薅羊毛：免费esim流量卡清单（本人已验证）

policy: Preserve the author's dated firsthand/community claims as evidence, including conditional eligibility, promo/referral codes, activation triggers, FUP/throttle limits and egress warnings. Do not convert them into provider-guaranteed facts without separate corroboration.

sourceContext.authorVerificationClaim: The author states all eight entries were personally tested and successfully claimed as of 2026-10-05.
sourceContext.egressWarning: Travel eSIMs commonly use home-routing/shared carrier egress, so exit IP may differ from the physical country and may be unsuitable for banking, streaming-region checks or account-registration workflows with strict risk controls.

offers.communityClaim: Watching one short ad unlocks 20 MB at up to 1 Mbps; rewards can stack, each unlocked allotment is valid for 7 days, and the author reports ads/data can be renewed repeatedly.
offers.eligibilityClaim: Free tier limited to users in North America, Europe and APAC according to the post.
offers.acquisition: Download Firsty App, install the eSIM once, then watch ads to unlock data.
notes: Source says one eSIM installation can be reused globally.
At 1 Mbps this is positioned for messaging, maps, email and ride-hailing rather than video or hotspot use.

offers.communityClaim: After any purchased Holafly eSIM package expires, the installed eSIM automatically receives 1 GB of backup data each month; unused monthly data does not roll over.
offers.eligibilityClaim: Conditional benefit for users who previously bought a Holafly eSIM package and keep the eSIM installed.
offers.acquisition: No additional action after an eligible paid Holafly package expires, according to the post.
notes: This is not a standalone free-new-user offer.
Monthly 1 GB does not stack; unused allowance expires.

offers.communityClaim: New users can claim 1 GB valid for 3 days across 81 destinations.
offers.acquisition: Download Nomad App, register an account and claim the trial.
notes: The post warns the eSIM must be installed within 15 days of claiming; otherwise it auto-activates and the 3-day countdown begins.

offers.communityClaim: A 300 MB / 1 day free eSIM can be claimed without a credit card for 12 Asian destinations.
offers.acquisition: Register through gohub.com/claim-free-esim, then install by QR code.
offers.activationTrigger: Validity starts on first data use according to the post.
notes: The source explicitly warns not to connect early because the 1-day window starts with first usage.

offers.communityClaim: The app promotion gives 3 days of unlimited data in one of seven eligible regions after Visa eligibility verification; the author reports virtual Visa cards can pass the binding check.
offers.cardEligibilityClaim: Visa Signature / Infinite; app verifies eligibility.
offers.coverageClaim: 7 Visa-designated regions; exact regions shown in app
offers.acquisition: Register in the GigSky App, bind an eligible Visa card, then redeem one of the seven regional offers.
offers.fupClaim: Unlimited data is subject to fair-use limits; the post reports roughly 2.5 GB of high-speed usage per day before throttling.
notes: The post says card binding is for eligibility verification and does not itself charge the card.

offers.communityClaim: Registration with referral code KL25629 gives 500 MB of global data without a credit card; limited-time gift code TRIPLE-A gives 1 GB through 2026-11-30.
offers.acquisition: Download Eskimo App and enter the applicable code during registration/redemption.
notes: The post says the data can remain valid for two years.
TRIPLE-A is explicitly time-limited and should remain versioned evidence rather than a permanent provider fact.

offers.communityClaim: New registration in the Red Bull MOBILE Data App includes an initial 100 MB free allowance.
offers.acquisition: Download Red Bull MOBILE Data App and register.
notes: The author characterizes the allowance as small and mainly worth claiming once.

offers.communityClaim: New users can claim 1 GB for 48 hours with Air France/KLM partner code AFKLDATA across 190+ countries.
offers.acquisition: Download Kolet App, register, enter AFKLDATA and install the eSIM.
offers.activationTrigger: The 48-hour period starts after landing and connecting to the local network, according to the post.
notes: The eSIM can be installed before travel and left inactive until arrival.
